gaps.explanation: Statement p4 total revenues 90,488,768. Detail = General Fund budget basis 68,418,989 (p5) + Community Betterment budget basis 1,167,158 (p6) + LB840 Funds 44,189 (p10) = 69,630,336. (1) Missing fund columns on p4 with no schedule: Debt Service Fund total revenues 8,096,111 (7,428,609 + 289,677 + 40,630 + 16,198 + 320,629 + 368) and Other Governmental Funds 510,441 (509,924 + 517) = 8,606,552, added below. (2) Different basis, no fix: General Fund GAAP column 80,714,197 vs budget-basis 68,418,989 (difference 12,295,208); Community Betterment GAAP 1,168,019 vs budget 1,167,158 (861); the LB840 Funds schedule (p10, 44,189) is not a separate column on p4 (its 519,856 economic development does not appear in Other Governmental Funds) so it sits inside the General Fund GAAP column: 12,295,208 + 861 - 44,189 = 12,251,880. Check: 8,606,552 + 12,251,880 = 20,858,432 = gap.
